changes.diff_text:
+How to migrate JMeter tests to Postman
+Giridhar
+Migrate a JMeter .jmx test plan to Postman with your coding agent: reuse requests, auth and assertions, then run load tests in CI.
+Read more →
+Postman Plugin for Claude Code: A Hands-On Guide
+Quinton Wall
+Install the Postman plugin for Claude Code, then build, mock, test, and gate an AI-native API with copy-paste prompts, hooks, and /goal.
+Read more →
-Your First Performance Test in Postman: A Quick Guide
-Giridhar
-Run your first performance test in Postman by reusing an existing collection. Set virtual users, thresholds, and gate CI with the Postman CLI. Try it now.
-Read more →
-Manage MCP context with Postman Fabric Gateway
-Gbadebo Bello
-Learn how to connect multiple MCP servers through Postman Fabric Gateway and enable progressive tool discovery to shrink your agent’s tool surface area.
-Read more →
